rules: imagery should have high appetite appeal
silo images should be photographed consistently according to packaging or product type
minimize reflections on plastic, foil, and shiny packaging, especially when covering important product information
remove unnecessary stickers not part of package design, such as special promotion stickers or legal declarations
packaging and labels should be presented straight, not angled or crooked
photograph each unique and meaningful side of the product package
for round or irregular shapes, present sides so printed information and graphics are centered and legible
front view is the side with predominant brand and labeling, format, variant, and size/quantity
products should be evenly lit from side to side and top to bottom
exposure and color should correctly represent the item
maintain separation between product and background
clip products onto pure white background, RGB 255/255/255
retouch dirt, dust, fingerprints, damage, blemishes, expiration dates, lot numbers, and sample-only information
lifestyle images should be realistic, professionally lit, and styled appropriately to the item and brand
product being sold should remain the hero of the lifestyle image
packaging should be incorporated into lifestyle images when practical to connect lifestyle images to silo shots
items must display all indicated required images and conditionally required images and meet the minimum image count listed on each page
maintain details in product whites and avoid flare or spill from the background
when possible, photograph the item without packaging and digitally apply artwork or labels for a clean, legible final image
use sharp focus on the featured product; softer background or foreground focus and white space may simplify the image
when the product and its packaging appear together, both must be in focus so packaging can be identified and read
maintain a consistent visual approach and consistent angles across the assortment for a unified PDP and shelf presentation
individual brand guidelines should take precedence

main_image.label: Main Image
main_image.description: Primary carousel image/hero image for the PDP.

silo_front.label: Silo, Front
silo_front.guidance: Show the product straight-on on a pure white background. Follow the product section for packaging and label requirements.
silo_front.recommendation: Add a straight-on front image on pure white following the product section guidance.

lifestyle_in_use.label: Lifestyle, In-Use
lifestyle_in_use.guidance: Show the product in a lifestyle setting that aligns with the brand.
lifestyle_in_use.recommendation: Add a lifestyle image showing the product in use in a setting that aligns with the brand.

feature_graphic.label: Feature Graphic
feature_graphic.guidance: Highlight a product feature or benefit using supporting text and graphics.
feature_graphic.recommendation: Add a feature graphic highlighting a product feature or benefit with supporting text and graphics.

silo_detail.label: Silo, Detail
silo_detail.guidance: Show the product out of packaging or in a close-up of key details such as filters, tips, or accessories in a clean, factual style.
silo_detail.recommendation: Add an out-of-pack or close-up detail image in a clean, factual style.

dimensions.label: Dimensions
dimensions.guidance: Show product dimensions in a graphic. For collectibles, use a scale avatar or apply product dimensions to the front-of-pack image.
dimensions.recommendation: Add a product dimensions graphic or the scale reference specified for the product section.

silo_front_in_pack.label: Silo, Front, In Pack
silo_front_in_pack.guidance: Show the front of the retail packaging straight-on on a pure white background when applicable.
silo_front_in_pack.recommendation: Add a straight-on front retail packaging image on pure white when applicable.

silo_back_in_pack.label: Silo, Back, In Pack
silo_back_in_pack.guidance: Show the back of product packaging straight-on on a pure white background with all label details legible.
silo_back_in_pack.recommendation: Add a straight-on back packaging image on pure white with all label details legible.

silo_assortment.label: Silo, Assortment
silo_assortment.guidance: Show all included pieces on white in a clean, organized arrangement.
silo_assortment.recommendation: Add an assortment image showing all included pieces arranged clearly on white.
